# Blue Collar AI

> Review, reputation, and tipping platform for towing companies and other blue-collar service crews.

Blue Collar AI lets service drivers collect customer ratings, feedback, and tips through a branded public page — shared by QR code or text link — while company admins manage drivers, branding, and tip reconciliation.

- [Home](/): What Blue Collar AI does and who it's for.
- [Sign in or sign up](/auth): Create an account or redeem a company invite.
